tests.title: Web POS takes 20% off when the cart exceeds the promo code threshold
tests.goal: Verify the discount amount on a qualifying basket.
preconditions: An active 20% promo code advertised for spending above HKD 50 applies to the selected store. Eligible products are available.
data: Use eligible items with no competing discount, or turn off unrelated basket offers for the cart.

steps.text: Log in to Storeberry with a staff account.
Open Web POS for a participating store.
Enter the promo code and click Apply.
Clear the test cart without checking out.

expected.text: The named offer deducts HKD 20 and the cart total is HKD 80.

notes: KN guest cart with snack01 and Gold inactive: HKD 100 subtotal, abovexcode took HKD 20 off, HKD 80 total. HK side check: item offer lowered snack01 to HKD 50; code then took HKD 10 off with Gold inactive.
